# Claw, phase 2: materials (Peachy Pop 16, sRGB 0..1 of the ramp steps), the lamp on the hub's front,
# hidden caps deleted, flat shading, export claw.glb. Generated by make_claw.py.
material new Hub --base-color 1.0 0.251 0.251 --no-slot
material new Chrome --base-color 0.624 0.725 1.0 --no-slot
material new Cable --base-color 0.325 0.012 0.294 --no-slot
material new Lamp --base-color 1.0 0.925 0.427 --no-slot
select Hub HubTop
material assign Hub
select Collar ProngB ProngL ProngR
material assign Chrome
select Cable
material assign Cable
add mesh cylinder --name Lamp --vertices 8 --radius 0.06 --depth 0.06 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
set location 0 -0.265 0.745
material assign Lamp
# caps inside the hub stack
active Hub
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
active HubTop
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
active Collar
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
active Cable
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select all
shade flat
export claw.glb
